notes.title: Survival Playtest Weekend
notes.notes:
[h3]The First Survival Playtest for PlanetSmith is LIVE![/h3]

This is your first chance to have a look at survival mode, come take part and give us your feedback.

We have added 14 achievements to collect and there are some community challenges and leaderboards that will extend the playtest length.

To celebrate we are having a speedrun challenge running on our [url=https://discord.gg/eSS2pYU7Nw]Discord[/url] and some special discord rolls you can obtain by taking part.

Also on discord we have a special bug reporting channel, ⁠[url=https://discord.com/channels/1117976254746988609/1202547847161978910]survival-bug-reports[/url] you can use with the new command /bug to send us bug reports about issues you've found. You can also react to other peoples bugs to upvote them in our system so we can see the really important ones that everyone's getting.

Happy PlanetSmithing!

notes.title: PlanetSmith Open Playtest Weekend!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44562960/35e85be1cf7a597fc1212d78d6ded89957f989a5.png[/img]

Greetings everyone!

We're happy to invite you to take part in our first playtest weekend which is now live!

To participate, make sure that you have requested access through our store page and don't forget to add PlanetSmith to your Steam wishlist!

We will also be having a timelapse build contest during the weekend in our official discord which can be joined [url=https://discord.gg/eSS2pYU7Nw]by clicking here![/url]

[b]To participate in the contest, be sure to upload a timelapse video to either Youtube or Tiktok and include #PlanetSmith in the description for your submission to count![/b]  

Once you have published your contest submission, be sure to post a link in the video-contest-submissions channel in our official discord and you will receive the limited time Playtest-1 role in our discord.

We will also be selecting winners once the playtest weekend concludes who will receive the coveted Master-Builder role to show off in our discord.

As this is an early look at PlanetSmith, we do expect there to be some bugs since this is the first large scale play test we have offered.  We would appreciate if you can take time to report any and all bugs you find throughout the weekend.  To make this easy on both our team and the players, a bug report form is available by [url=https://forms.gle/qAvEGwWpdN85frmHA]clicking here![/url]

We hope you enjoy playing and be sure to reach out to our team with any questions and feedback through our discord!

notes.title: PlanetSmith Dev Livestream
notes.notes:
Ken will be livestreaming while playing PlanetSmith's creative mode. He'll be happy to answer any of your questions and demonstrate the game to you all.

He will talk about what's in the game for the Steam Early Access release this year and also what is planned for the future of the game.

This is a great opportunity to ask any questions you have!
